correctness.rationale: For a nonzero rank-one map \(R=u\otimes\ell\), direct substitution gives the binary defect \(-2\ell(e_4)(\ell(x)h(y)-\ell(y)h(x))u\), with \(h(x)=u_1x_2-u_2x_1\), and a ternary defect divisible by the same factor. In characteristic different from \(2\), this is equivalent to \(\ell(e_4)=0\) or \(u_1=u_2=0\). The actual bundled checker verifies these symbolic identities and exhaustively confirms the intrinsic criterion on all rank-at-most-one matrices over \(\mathbf F_3\).

value.rationale: Rank one is the natural minimal nonzero stratum in an operator variety, not an arbitrary parameter slice. Here that stratum admits a complete intrinsic image/kernel description, decomposes into two determinantal components with a controlled intersection, and yields exact finite-field and zeta data. It also proves concretely that the large displayed source family does not exhaust even the minimal-rank operators, which is useful evidence for any future full moduli classification.
